editorial.blurb: Anteprima delivers the quality and refinement of fine dining in a warm, approachable setting where you can linger over shared plates on their coveted heated patio.
editorial.insiderTip: Book ahead for Friday or Saturday; weekday evenings offer walk-in patio seating, and the quartino format lets you explore wines that pair beautifully with the menu.
signatureDishes: Braised beef with mashed potatoes and brussels sprouts
